item.title: A Second Look: The Positives and Negatives of AI (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Megyn Kelly looks back at her past interviews in the archives on AI, including a Nick Bostrom interview from more than 5 years ago, a deep dive with Tristan Harris, and a fascinating conversation with AI whistleblower Jacob Coxon.
